stem: 以下哪项陈述最能描述与守门人相关的金融犯罪风险？

options.A: 守门人掌握着专门的知识,这些知识可能被滥用,从而为非法资金的流动提供便利,并掩盖其客户参与非法活动的事实.
options.B: 守门人职位具有隐蔽性,这往往使其财富来源难以核实.
options.C: 守门人具有独特的关系结构,这使得确定最终受益人变得困难.
options.D: 守门人被赋予了重要的职能和行为准则,这可能有助于洗钱活动.

stem_en: Which of the following statements best describes the financial crime risk associated with gatekeepers?

options_en.A: Gatekeepers have specialized knowledge that can be abused to facilitate the movement of illicit funds and conceal the involvement of their clients in illicit schemes.
options_en.B: Gatekeeper positions are of a secretive nature, often making it difficult to verify their source of wealth.
options_en.C: Gatekeepers have unique relationship structures, making it difficult to determine beneficial ownership.
options_en.D: Gatekeepers are entrusted with prominent functions and codes of conduct that may facilitate money laundering activities.
